title: Make service desk the deployed default scenario
description: Investigate why the va-demo PSTN destination answers with Concierge even though recent work intended service desk to be the default. Fix the root cause across configuration/deployment/runtime surfaces, add regression coverage, and verify readiness reports ServiceDeskIntakeAgent.
close_reason: Root cause fixed across backend runtime defaults, Cascade/VoiceLive precedence, readiness reporting, live App.jsx browser URL construction, and azd/App Configuration scenario reconciliation. 35 focused tests and frontend build pass; existing va-demo requires backend redeployment.

title: Build service desk PSTN caller simulator
description: Create an isolated .NET 10 WinForms application that calls the deployed service-desk agent over PSTN, acts as an editable English/German scripted caller, streams and monitors live audio, exposes ACS callbacks through a session Dev Tunnel, and supports early hang-up. Implement with sequential reviewed subagents and validate with automated tests plus a live smoke test.
close_reason: Implemented and reviewed isolated WinForms PSTN caller simulator; 294 tests pass and real ACS/tunnel lifecycle smoke succeeded. Full conversation smoke is blocked by destination deployment missing IncomingCall Event Grid subscription and service_desk scenario activation.

title: Add German-to-Polish caller preset
description: Add a selectable simulator script that opens in German and deterministically switches caller replies and TTS voice to Polish after the first finalized service-desk turn. Keep behavior visible in the UI, editable facts intact, and add regression coverage.
close_reason: Added reviewed German-to-Polish showcase preset with deterministic prompt/TTS switch and 317 passing tests.
